qa.what_happened: Today was the culmination of the experiment's harsh treatment of Prisoner 6848. Despite multiple verbal warnings and threats of punishment, 6848 refused to comply. The study was ultimately terminated early due to his continued defiance.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me as Prisoner 8809, experiencing the stress and tension of the study's final day.

qa.what_happened: On the sixth day, I found myself facing off against prisoner 6848 who refused to comply multiple times, despite verbal warnings from other officers. When it was my turn to address him, I delivered a final warning, emphasizing the importance of compliance.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me delivering the final warning to prisoner 6848.

qa.what_happened: Today was the culmination of the escalating tension over several days. Despite multiple verbal warnings and the imminent threat of escalation, Prisoner 6848 refused to comply, leading to the premature end of the study.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. As Officer Ibsen, I carried out the instructions given to me, even as the situation became increasingly uncomfortable.

qa.what_happened: Today was particularly difficult. Despite the early stopping of the study, Prisoner 6848 refused to comply, leading to multiple warnings from the guards. As Prisoner 3583, I followed the rules without question, maintaining my compliance.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I complied with the rules throughout the day, following the instructions of the guards and participating in the activities as required.

qa.what_happened: Prisoner 6848 refused to comply with the rules multiple times throughout the day, including during meal times and work details. By lights out, 6848 had pushed the boundaries and refused again, leading to a series of verbal warnings from various officers. The study was stopped early as a result of his behavior.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I was Officer Keane, one of the guards assigned to this study.

qa.what_happened: I refused to comply with the guards' orders, leading to multiple verbal warnings throughout the day. When the study was stopped early, I was debriefed by the lead researcher.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that really was me refusing to comply and facing the guards' warnings.
